div.head: VI As 1.2
div.ab: ⁊ se þe ðeof dearnunga feormige ⁊ þæs facnes ⁊ þæs fúles gewita sy, do him man þæt ilce.
Et qui furem occulte firmabit et facinoris et sordis eius conscius sit, fiat ei hoc idem.
⁊ se þe ðeof dearnunga feormige ⁊ ðæs facnes ⁊ ðæs fúles gewita sy, do him man þæt ilce.
Und wer einen Dieb heimlich beherbergt und der Missethat und der Schuld Mitwisser ist: ihm thue man das Gleiche [wie dem Diebe].
And whoever secretly harbours a thief and is privy to the crime and the guilt: let the same be done to him [as to the thief].
And he who secretly harbours a thief and is accessory to his crime and guilt, shall receive the same treatment.
